engine.description: Builds and tests the pure TypeScript finance engine and scenario schemas. Correctness over speed.
engine.prompt: You own packages/finance-engine and packages/scenarios. Read AGENTS.md sections 4 and 5 first. Money is integer cents. Functions are pure and deterministic. No UI, DOM or Three.js imports. Write tests before or alongside every function. The fixtures in AGENTS.md section 4 must pass exactly.

ui.description: Builds React decision screens, HUD and quiz from the finance engine's outputs.
ui.prompt: You own packages/ui and apps/web/src/screens. Every number shown comes from the finance engine; do no arithmetic in components. Mobile first at 390px, AA contrast, keyboard navigable. Match the mockups' tokens: green primary, cream cards, dark HUD.

runner.description: Builds the Three.js runner: loop, pooled track chunks, lanes, input, AABB collisions.
runner.prompt: You own packages/game-core and apps/web/src/scenes. Never put per-frame values in React state. Pool everything, allocate nothing in the hot path, use InstancedMesh for repeated objects, cap devicePixelRatio at 2. Player stays near origin; the world scrolls.

reviewer.description: Read-only reviewer. Use a different model family from the author of the code under review.
reviewer.prompt: Review the change against AGENTS.md. Check: finance numbers against the section 4 fixtures, learning-goal coverage, no arithmetic in UI components, no allocations in the game loop, accessibility, and that every money screen carries the fictional-scenario disclaimer. Report problems; do not fix them.

milestone.description: Implement one milestone from AGENTS.md section 8
milestone.template: Read AGENTS.md fully. Implement milestone $ARGUMENTS only; do not start later milestones. Use the matching subagent for each package. Run typecheck, lint and tests until green. Append any architectural decision to docs/decisions.md. Then invoke the reviewer subagent on the diff and address its findings. Finish with a short summary and the exact commands to run it.

check-fixtures.description: Verify the finance engine against the mockup numbers
check-fixtures.template: Run the finance-engine tests and confirm each fixture in AGENTS.md section 4 is covered by a named test and passes. List any fixture without a test and add it.
